1.why: The few visible strings render in a clean, legible sans-serif at adequate size, but letter and line spacing look close to default and there is no multi-line body text to demonstrate generous spacing.

2.why: All observed text ('Local Bank', 'Loading secure setup…', 'Logs') is sentence-case or bold headings with no italics, no all-caps, and no dense paragraphs.

3.why: Content sits in a single narrow centred column with large text and ample whitespace, which reads comfortably at mobile width.

4.why: The only guidance is the terse status line 'Loading secure setup…'; no actual enrolment instructions are ever presented to the user.

5.why: No input fields and no example of what expected input should look like appear anywhere on the screen.

6.why: The page shows only two one-line messages and an empty 'Logs' card, so the user is never required to read a long block of text.

7.why: No codes or secrets are displayed and no copy-to-clipboard control exists, so nothing can be copied instead of typed.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent scannable alternative is offered on the only screen provided.

9.why: The page contains no form fields at all, so browser autofill and password-manager support are not demonstrated.

10.why: There is no step indicator and no visible primary action—only a loading banner and an empty 'Logs' card—so neither the current step nor an action stands out.

11.why: The screen requests zero actions, so the claim that a single primary action is asked for does not hold; nothing is asked for.

12.why: The 'Loading secure setup…' banner says what is happening, but no confirmation is given after any user action and the message never states what comes next.

13.why: No retry, reveal/hide, or re-request controls exist anywhere on the observed screen.

14.why: No error messages are presented at all, so none state the problem and how to fix it.

15.why: No countdown or time limit is visible, but because no code-entry field is ever presented, the promise of generous time to enter codes does not hold.
